N1.interpretation: Only whitening-estimation component; not confirmation/refutation of unrestricted noisy coupling

definitions.tokens: Full generated completion token count from archived E4, no re-tokenization
definitions.ast_steps: Number of exact AST observer points, only when nodes and points are present; no estimated lengths
definitions.tactics: AST kinds combined within exported observation rows; percentages conditional on observed types
definitions.populations: ProofNet E1 learned audit categories; miniF2F archived Table1 eligibility audit categories

N7.comparison: Full state X versus matching no-token-length baseline; retrospective localization

N8a.formula_extremes: c_ext=-log(1-theta_runs1*fbar); fbar=exceedances/steps over eligible calibration traces; theta_runs1=clusters/exceedances (run length1)
N8a.formula_success: MLE of p_goal(L)=exp(-c_goal L) on all original calibration tasks; L is controlled task depth, not emitted proof length.
N8a.threshold: Quantiles of successful calibration step norms; choose q maximizing whole-trace Youden TPR-FPR on calibration eligible failures/verified; tie higher threshold. Whitening calibrated on the same successful calibration traces, so these quantiles are in-sample relative to whitening.
N8a.limits: Historical exploratory comparison; calibration uncertainty was not propagated. Neither coefficient alone identifies a heavy-tail mechanism. No new coefficient calculation.

N8b.formula: p(r)=sum_{z1 in first-error train} weight(z1) F0_strict(z1)^(r-1); F0 from accepted-prefix training steps
N8b.weighting: Within each phase, equal exercise groups then equal steps in group (not equal attempts). Heldout summaries equal groups then attempts.
N8b.pooled: All training accepted-prefix and first-error values within model and outer fold.
N8b.conditioned: Both training phases restricted to heldout final/error tactic family and failure-prefix length bin 2-4,5-10,11+; if either has fewer than20 groups fallback pooled.
N8b.observed: Earliest argmax within prefix1..t* equals t*, failed attempts t*>=2.

N8c.meaning: Count of learned-population proofs whose final AST tactic kind is Lean.Parser.Tactic.exact. This is a syntax category, not exact localization accuracy.

N9a.criterion: Holm p and conservative simultaneous Bonferroni CI; primary two ProofNet cells

N9bc.Putnam_OOF: not part of required frozen transfer; optional extension not run
N9bc.N9c: Goedel PST and MD_noN included for ProofNet/miniF2F OOF and frozen Putnam
N9bc.interpretation: Learned target-dependent directions, no label-free or independent-noise claim
